theme_stances.key_argument: Hyperscaler capex is driving a massive earnings expansion for the AI food chain.
theme_stances.evidence: We are clearly in an AI Capex boom.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI is driving a structural shift in earnings that is expected to be sustained.
theme_stances.evidence: US earnings are breaking out on the upside, with Binky and Parag expecting this to be sustained

theme_stances.key_argument: The AI build-out is a structural force requiring massive capital that is keeping global yields elevated.
theme_stances.evidence: AI is becoming a macro variable... 'the most capital-hungry investment cycle in history.'

theme_stances.key_argument: The assumption of limitless, elastic demand for compute is a structural blind spot that ignores potential limits to model scaling and task tractability.
theme_stances.evidence: There is no iron law that says this scaling will continue

theme_stances.key_argument: Scarcity across compute and energy remains a theme well into 2027, supporting long-term infrastructure investment.
theme_stances.evidence: stay long AI infra as scarcity across compute & energy remains a theme

theme_stances.key_argument: Improving macro, weaker USD, and AI CapEx tailwinds support EM performance.
theme_stances.evidence: We are bullish on EM given (i) improving macro; (ii) weaker USD; (iii) AI CapEx tailwinds

theme_stances.key_argument: Commodities are shifting from tactical inflation hedges to strategic assets benefiting from AI infrastructure and reshoring.
theme_stances.evidence: Together, these forces are turning parts of the asset class from purely cyclical exposures

theme_stances.key_argument: The massive investment by hyperscalers is driving a synchronized earnings expansion across the AI food chain.
theme_stances.evidence: The top 5 capex spenders are spending more than double that of the remaining 495

theme_stances.key_argument: CoreWeave is successfully shifting toward higher-value software and managed services to create more durable revenue streams.
theme_stances.evidence: Over time, we believe these software and services layers should carry higher strategic value

theme_stances.key_argument: Microsoft is successfully shifting to outcome-based billing which expands the software TAM.
theme_stances.evidence: AI is not just an efficiency tool but a mechanism for expanding software spend

theme_stances.key_argument: West Coast markets are seeing accelerating rent growth driven by AI job hiring and improving migration trends.
theme_stances.evidence: West Coast markets continue to outperform other regions (ex-LA), driving ESS to have the highest market-weighted rent growth.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI is shifting from experimentation to enterprise architecture, with security and model optimization as key enablers.
theme_stances.evidence: Day 2 reinforced that AI is moving from experimentation into enterprise architecture.

theme_stances.key_argument: Corporate America will continue to invest in AI as a necessary tool for business improvement and protection.
theme_stances.evidence: the secular trend of broad-based AI spending remains intact

theme_stances.key_argument: Enterprises are moving beyond productivity tools toward rearchitecting end-to-end workflows.
theme_stances.evidence: enterprises only beginning to move beyond productivity tools

theme_stances.key_argument: Humanoid robots and physical AI are moving from conceptual stages to industrialization faster than anticipated.
theme_stances.evidence: Humanoid robots are moving from PowerPoint to industrialization much faster than expected.

theme_stances.key_argument: Convertible bonds are providing an attractive funding source for AI infrastructure due to tight credit spreads and capex needs.
theme_stances.evidence: convertible bonds remain uniquely positioned to deliver asymmetric risk/reward profiles

theme_stances.key_argument: BAC's disciplined, subscription-based AI strategy avoids the token-cost pressures seen elsewhere in the industry.
theme_stances.evidence: BAC has been relatively unaffected, as they have negotiated subscription based arrangements

theme_stances.key_argument: Management teams from Dell, TSMC, and Applied Materials all point to strong, multi-year demand visibility for AI-related hardware.
theme_stances.evidence: market is in the early stages of a durable, multi-year AI infrastructure buildout

theme_stances.key_argument: AI-related investment and debt issuance remain strong, with convertible bonds offering attractive total returns.
theme_stances.evidence: AI-related investment growth remains strong and that enterprise AI adoption continues to rise gradually

theme_stances.key_argument: Agentic AI is driving structural, multi-year demand tailwinds across the semiconductor supply chain.
theme_stances.evidence: Companies highlighted higher structural demand driven by AI, which are driving capacity additions

theme_stances.key_argument: Lam Research is benefiting from strong AI-driven demand and 3D architecture inflections like GAA and backside power delivery.
theme_stances.evidence: Lam Research highlighted strong, AI-driven demand across its customer base

theme_stances.key_argument: SoftBank has become a highly liquid expression of the AI theme, with pricing gaps across instruments that are too wide to ignore.
theme_stances.evidence: SoftBank Group (BB+/Ba2/NR) is no longer just an investment holding company

theme_stances.key_argument: AI capex is the key growth engine for the global economy and remains the primary focus for equity investors.
theme_stances.evidence: AI capex is the key growth engine

theme_stances.key_argument: Current valuations of AI-related stocks are unsustainable and likely to lead to disappointing future returns.
theme_stances.evidence: today it looks at least as unlikely for the traditional 60/40 to deliver 5% real over the coming years

theme_stances.key_argument: Value has outperformed growth outside the US for some time and offers a hedge against AI-risk.
theme_stances.evidence: The Value style has been outperforming Growth outside the US for some time

theme_stances.key_argument: A broadening capex cycle beyond Big Tech is providing a new engine of growth for the global economy.
theme_stances.evidence: The underlying reason for this resilience can be traced back to a nascent capex cycle

theme_stances.key_argument: The scale and speed of the current AI investment cycle bear clear similarities to historical precedents of over-investment.
theme_stances.evidence: The scale and speed of the current AI investment cycle... bear clear similarities to these historical precedents

theme_stances.key_argument: Geopolitical conflicts, fiscal deficits, and AI borrowing are keeping rates elevated globally.
theme_stances.evidence: add up to a scenario of high rates for longer.

theme_stances.key_argument: Europe's investment in AI, electrification, and defense provides a resilient growth foundation despite energy costs.
theme_stances.evidence: Europe’s structural investment cycle should remain supported by efforts to strengthen domestic production
